amendments.body: Fix compilation errors: three functions (density_repro_factor, tan_repro_factor, no2_repro_factor) are defined twice in crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs with divergent implementations (lines ~1449-1487 vs ~1503-1541). Additionally, snapshot.rs:338 calls dominant_repro_suppression() which does not exist anywhere in the codebase. The code cannot compile at all. Remove the duplicate definitions (keeping whichever version is intended) and either implement dominant_repro_suppression or remove the repro_dominant_suppression field from TankSnapshot.
amendments.rationale: The project does not build. cargo build produces E0428 (duplicate definitions) and E0425 (function not found). No tests can run and no features can be verified.

amendments.body: Fix the test_denitrification_reduces_nitrate_accumulation integration test (crates/tank_core/tests/denitrification.rs). The active_denitrification case uses SubstrateKind::ActivePlanted with nutrient_store_mg_n_total=50.0 while the control uses InertSand with nutrient_store_mg_n_total=0.0. This 50mg N reservoir leaks into the water column and overwhelms denitrification, causing with_denit to finish with HIGHER NO3 (24.89 mg/L) than without_denit (19.00 mg/L). Either equalize the nutrient stores between cases or remove the store from the active case so the only controlled variable is suboxic zone geometry and denitrifier activity.
amendments.rationale: The test was un-ignored in this changeset but fails immediately: 'Active denitrification should finish with lower NO3 concentration: with_denit=24.89 mg/L, without_denit=19.00 mg/L'. The assertion is inverted because the fixture introduces a confounding nitrogen source.

amendments.body: Apply the same division-by-zero guard to ca_min_mg_per_l and mg_min_mg_per_l that was applied to gh_min_d. In update_molt_stress (shrimp.rs:459,464), ca_stress and mg_stress divide by params.ca_min_mg_per_l and params.mg_min_mg_per_l respectively without a .max(0.01) guard. Similarly, molt_mineral_modifier (shrimp.rs:1559-1560) divides by ca_min_mg_per_l and mg_min_mg_per_l without guards. If a user sets these parameters to zero (as the test_zero_gh_min_parameter_uses_defensive_guard test exercises for gh_min_d), NaN/Inf propagates through stress and molt calculations.
amendments.rationale: The gh_min_d fix correctly identified the division-by-zero pattern but only fixed one of three instances. The same class of bug remains for the Ca and Mg parameters. Consistency with the gh_min_d fix is important since all three share identical code structure.

amendments.body: Remove or use EventCause::HighDensity (crates/tank_core/src/types/events.rs:49). The variant was added in this changeset but is never emitted by any code path — no call site references EventCause::HighDensity.
amendments.rationale: Dead enum variant added without any producer. If density-related events are intended (e.g. in egg_dropping or mortality), the emit call is missing. If not needed, the variant should be removed to avoid confusion.

payload.summary: Code does not compile due to duplicate function definitions and a missing function. The integration test that was un-ignored is also failing. Four issues total: two critical (compilation failures), one correctness bug (failing test), and one minor (incomplete div-by-zero guard pattern).
